description: This file defines the interface 'JsonApiResourceIdentifier' within the SuiteCRM project, specifying contract methods for resource identification in the JSON API v1 module.

classes.name: JsonApiResourceIdentifier
classes.description: An interface defining methods for obtaining and setting resource identifiers (ID and type) in the JSON API context.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID as a string.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the resource ID, returning the Resource or the current instance for chaining.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the resource type as a string.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the resource type, returning the Resource or the current instance for chaining.
